resources.string: Connect to Gibbous on your computer. On a signed-in device, open Settings → Devices to show your sign-in code.
Point at the sign-in code in Settings → Devices
Replies and agents waiting for you
Gibbous will sign in to the server at %1$s.
That sign-in link isn\'t valid. Scan the code in Settings → Devices again.
That code isn\'t a Gibbous sign-in code.
Use the https sign-in link (Tailscale). Plain http only works for a server on this device.
That isn\'t a Gibbous sign-in link. It looks like https://your-computer…ts.net:8444/login?token=…
Copy the sign-in link first, then tap Paste.
You\'re signed out. Scan the sign-in code again to continue.
That sign-in link wasn\'t accepted. Scan the current code in Settings → Devices on your computer.
The server doesn\'t answer to %1$s. Use the sign-in link from Settings → Devices.
This phone is offline. Gibbous will reconnect as soon as it\'s back online.
%1$s needs an https address. Use the Tailscale sign-in link from Settings → Devices.
%1$s answered with a certificate this phone doesn\'t trust.
%1$s isn\'t answering. Check that the computer is awake, Gibbous is running and Tailscale is on for both devices.
No app on this phone opens that link.
